App Library behavior vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume App Library support on device covers storefront language. Category folders, hide-from-Home-Screen toggles, and Connect actually separate in-app App Library behavior from product-page copy:

  • Swipe past the last Home Screen page — the gesture buyers use to open App Library. Controls on-device navigation — not App Store language. AppLocale does not perform this.
  • Auto-categorized folders — iOS groups apps into folders like Productivity, Social, Utilities, and Entertainment. Listing copy should name that organization; building category detection is engineering work, not Connect metadata.
  • Recently Added — a dedicated App Library folder for apps installed recently. zh-Hans overlays should use 最近添加 when your English frames show that badge — not English-only "Recently Added" pasted through machine translation.
  • App Library Search — the search field at the top of App Library that finds installed apps by name. zh-Hans copy should use 应用资料库搜索 or 资料库内搜索 when your gallery shows that bar — distinct from Spotlight or Siri search marketing.
  • Hide from Home Screen — apps removed from Home Screen pages but still visible in App Library. Product-page copy names that workflow; implementing hide-app toggles is engineering.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of App Library support in the binary.

FAQ

How does iPhone App Library organize apps?

App Library sits after the last Home Screen page. iOS automatically groups installed apps into category folders — Productivity, Social, Utilities, Entertainment — plus a Recently Added folder and an App Library Search field at the top. Listing copy should name that auto-categorized drawer when your gallery shows it.

How is App Library different from Home Screen icon layout?

Home Screen icon layout covers jiggle mode, drag-and-drop icons, and folders on Home Screen pages. App Library is the separate drawer buyers reach by swiping past the final page — auto-sorted categories, Recently Added, and in-drawer search.

What is App Library Search in zh-Hans copy?

The search field at the top of App Library that finds installed apps by name. Use 应用资料库搜索 or 资料库内搜索 on frames that show that bar — not widget search or Control Center vocabulary unless your listing pairs those surfaces.

What is the Recently Added category?

An App Library folder surfacing apps installed recently, separate from auto-generated category folders. Use 最近添加 when your gallery shows that badge.

Why does zh-Hans copy need 应用资料库 instead of 小组件?

小组件 names Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets. 应用资料库, App 资料库, and 应用库 name Apple's auto-categorized app drawer. Using 小组件 on App Library frames misfiles your app as a widget utility in China Search.

Does App Library support auto-fill my China listing?

No. Hide-from-Home-Screen behavior and App Library navigation control runtime iOS — they do not create or fill a zh-Hans localization row. Empty or English Connect fields mean English fallback on the China storefront.

Widgets cover 小组件 gallery marketing. Control Center covers 控制中心 toggles. Focus covers 专注模式 notification profiles. This page is App Library — the auto-categorized app drawer after the last Home Screen page.
